name: modal-sandbox
description: Plan and run safe, reproducible workflows in Modal Sandboxes.

interface.longDescription: Guides agents through resource-free planning, preview-before-live execution, cleanup, workflow benchmarking, persistent files, and reusable Modal Sandbox workflows using the CLI as the execution engine.
defaultPrompt: Run this task in an isolated, reproducible Modal Sandbox.
Plan a safe Modal Sandbox workflow before running it.
Benchmark these equivalent workflows under the same sandbox controls.
Use a Modal volume to persist these workspace files.
Inspect and clean up Modal Sandbox resources.
Start a reusable Modal Sandbox for this coding task.
